newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares close up on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares close up on institutional buying.

text.p: Jakarta share prices closed higher on Tuesday on institutional buying of a few heavyweight stocks in late trade following support from regional markets, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index rose 7.54 points, or 1.36 percent, to close at 561.94 points. Gainers led losers by 55 to 35, with 57 counters unchanged.
"The market is likely to be active tommorrow as more foreigners are taking a buy side," a foreign broker said.
Another foreign broker said stronger regional markets had boosted sentiment towards a few blue chips in late afternoon trade.
Blue-chip telecommunications firm Telkom, satellite firm Indosat and car-maker Astra International were among the targets for foreign operators.
Diversified firm Bimantara Citra topped the active list with 9.9 million shares traded, rising 175 rupiah to 2,600 on foreign-buying.
Pharmaceuticals firm Darya Varia rose 525 rupiah, or 15 percent, to 4,025 on a volume of 1.4 million shares.

Property and roads contractor Summarecon was up 100 rupiah to 1,600 on a volume of 2.3 million shares on talk that the firm had won a tender to build a toll road despite company denial that the tender had yet been announced.
